prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1455; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle side-impact collision. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound through the intersection when the front of the vehicle struck the driver's side of a second sedan, operated by Driver 2, which had entered the intersection from the eastbound approach. Airbag deployment was observed in both vehicles. A single passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and was uninjured. Driver 2 stated the signal had changed to green before proceeding. Driver 1 stated they had entered on a yellow light. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was transported by EMS for evaluation. Driver 2 declined medical treatment at the scene. Both vehicles sustained significant damage and were towed from the roadway. Traffic control was established until the lanes were cleared. Citations are pending review of traffic signal timing records and witness statements.
